root_cause.text: The port->aggregator pointer in the 802.3ad bonding code was accessed without proper RCU protection, causing a data race between the workqueue handler that updates it (ad_port_selection_logic) and concurrent readers (e.g., bond_3ad_get_active_agg_info).
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the `__rcu` qualifier to the `aggregator` field in `struct port` and replaces all direct accesses with RCU primitives (`rcu_dereference`, `rcu_assign_pointer`, `RCU_INIT_POINTER`), and adds `rcu_read_lock`/`rcu_read_unlock` around reader call sites. The KCSAN trace confirms a write in `ad_port_selection_logic` (line 1659) and a read in `__bond_3ad_get_active_agg_info` (line 2858), both accessing the same memory location without any synchronization.
